headline: How to Avoid Common Custom Kitchen Design Mistakes
articleBody: Designing a custom kitchen is exciting, but it’s easy to stumble if you’re not careful. One big mistake is underestimating storage needs; people often focus on aesthetics and forget about practical space for all their gadgets and pantry items. Another common slip-up is neglecting the 'work triangle' – the flow between your sink, stove, and refrigerator. An inefficient layout can make cooking a chore, even in a beautiful new space. Also, not planning for proper lighting, both ambient and task-specific, can make your custom kitchen feel dim or uninviting. Overlooking adequate ventilation for your cooking habits is another no-no, leading to lingering odors and grease. Finally, rushing the material selection process can lead to choices you regret later; take your time with custom cabinets, quartz, and stone countertops.
